title: DisCo Algebra: Why Disintegration and Combination Are Not Inverses
abstract: arXiv:2610.15006v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present DisCo algebra---a compositional framework for joint probability built from a symmetric cooperad (disintegration) and a non-unital partial symmetric operad (combination restricted to the image of disintegration) on the bare family $\mathcal{P}_n=\mathrm{Prob}([0,1]^n)$. No probability integral transform, no external summary functions, no enrichment of objects with conditional kernels. The disintegration side uses block-wise joint CDFs as intrinsic, measure-determined 1D summaries, yielding a lossy compression. The combination side reads the same summaries and reconstructs via regular conditional measures, yielding a lossless embedding on admissible inputs. We prove that combination followed by disintegration is the identity on admissible inputs, but disintegration followed by combination is not---it defines a renormalization operator $R_{\mathcal{I}}=\text{Combine}\circ\text{Disintegrate}$. translated_title: DisCo代数：为什么分解与组合并非互逆运算
translated_abstract: 我们提出了DisCo代数——一个建立在裸族 $\mathcal{P}_n=\mathrm{Prob}([0,1]^n)$ 之上的联合概率组合式框架，由一个对称余操作（disintegration，即分解）和一个非单位部分对称操作（combination，即限制在分解像上的组合）构成。该框架不需要概率积分变换，不需要外部汇总函数，也不需要用条件核对对象进行富集。分解一侧使用分块联合累积分布函数（CDF）作为内在的、由测度决定的一维摘要，从而实现有损压缩；组合一侧读取相同的摘要，并通过正则条件测度进行重构，在可允许输入上实现无损嵌入。我们证明：先组合后分解在可允许输入上是恒等操作，但先分解后组合则不是——后者定义了一个重正化算子 $R_{\mathcal{I}}=\text{Combine}\circ\text{Disintegrate}$。该算子的信息损失……
tldr: 本文提出DisCo代数框架，用对称余操作刻画联合概率的分解、用非单位部分操作刻画组合，证明“组合∘分解”在可允许输入上是恒等操作，而“分解∘组合”则是一个有信息损失的重正化算子，从而揭示了分解与组合并非互逆。
en_tdlr: DisCo algebra formalizes joint probability via a symmetric cooperad (disintegration) and a non-unital partial operad (combination), proving that Combine∘Disintegrate is the identity on admissible inputs while Disintegrate∘Combine defines an information-losing renormalization operator—hence the two operations are not inverses.
